author: ios newby
title: Crossfade issues
content: So I’ve been using this app for a while. But of late there’s been an issue with crossfade. The music begins to play when crossing to the next song and then stops outputting audio. The song shows as playing but no sound. It’s worked flawlessly until now. Also why do I need to find my on device music folder in the the documents folder when it’s definitely saved in the Evermusic folder? It used to always be found in the music app folder but now I have to find the folder in documents. A bit stupid when the music folder isn’t even saved there.

author: xxxDIRTSxxx
title: Wants access to ALL of your cloud files
content: Paid for this. Unfortunately didn’t install it. When it asked for access to my cloud files it wanted access to EVERYTHING file of mine, not just my music. Why? Too intrusive. Wasted my money
